name: osint-overview
description: Use when the engagement requires passive reconnaissance only — no packets to the target's authoritative infrastructure. Splits off from the Recon agent so bug-bounty and pre-engagement work can run with outbound-only network policy. Maltego, Shodan, Censys, Hunter.io, breach-data lookups, GitHub code search, Wayback Machine archives, certificate transparency, BGP/ASN mapping.
